description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Delivery Document with Credit Block provides a way to interact with the [Delivery Document with Credit Block - Read, Check, Release, Reject (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_DEL_DOC_WITH_CREDIT_BLOCK/overview). The service allows to read delivery documents that are blocked by credit management and the reasons for rejection, and to check, release or reject the credit block of a delivery document.
key-features: Read delivery documents that are blocked by credit management
Check, release or reject the credit block of a delivery document
Read the sales document reasons for rejection
